description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for the Cryptographer utility in the OrangeHRM project. It contains test cases to verify encryption and decryption functionalities of the Cryptographer class.

classes.name: CryptographerTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case for testing the Cryptographer utility methods, including encryption and decryption functions.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the Cryptographer instance with a specific key before each test.

methods.name: testEncrypt
methods.description: Tests that encrypting a string produces the expected encrypted output.

methods.name: testDecrypt
methods.description: Tests that decrypting an encrypted string reproduces the original input.

methods.name: testEncryptDecrypt
methods.description: Verifies that encrypting and then decrypting a value yields the original value.
